facts.text: Email telemetry available from Business Central 2020 release wave 2, update 17.2 and later.
Email telemetry collects data on successful sends and failed send attempts.
SMTP authentication and connection telemetry added from 2023 release wave 1, update 23.2 and later.
Email must be set up before email telemetry data can be collected.
Failed emails are viewable in Email Outbox page in Business Central client.
Telemetry captures email provider connector used such as Current User, Microsoft 365, SMTP, or custom connectors.
